title: deyeuxia hygrometrica
intro: Deyeuxia hygrometrica, commonly known as Qing Mai, is a type of plant native to China that has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. Qing Mai has been used to treat various health conditions, including its potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Qing Mai are attributed to its ability to promote blood circulation, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Qing Mai include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
